interface.name: together_dock_dodge_manager_v1

description.summary: track whether windows obscure a surface

interface.description: Allows a client to register a wl_surface and receive updates whenever a window from the compositor overlaps and obscures that surface.

request.name: get_dock_dodge_surface

description.summary: create an obscuration tracker for a surface

request.description: Register a wl_surface which should be monitored for obscuration.

interface.name: together_dock_dodge_surface_v1

description.summary: obscuration state for a registered surface

interface.description: Emits the current obscuration state for the registered surface.

entry.name: obscured
entry.summary: the surface is obscured by a window

event.name: obscured
event.description: Sent whenever the compositor detects that the tracked surface became obscured or unobscured.
